notes:
Prospect: Voyantix Product AI — mid-market analytics SaaS. Evaluating hosted API first; POC positive, moving to Dedicated for predictable per-customer latency and cost controls.

Key technical reqs: low 95/99p latency for chat and embeddings (<250ms preferred for short queries), steady embedding throughput ~120 reqs/s peak, KV cache reuse across sessions, region residency (US-EAST).

Pricing/packaging negotiation specifics (current):
- They want a 12-month committed capacity contract but propose a lower base commit for Q2 with explicit ramp schedule into Q3/Q4.
- Asking for burst pool: need to support +50% peak for 10% of hours. Request: burst without immediate overage charges for first 6 months of ramp.
- Overage: customer prefers per-minute billing on overage; Redwood current model is per-hour granularity for GPU billing — legal/product needs to confirm.
- Proposed commercial: $150k first-year commit with a 3-month linear ramp (25% -> 50% -> 100%), followed by automatic increase capped at 20% if usage growth hits thresholds.
- AE notes: counter-offer includes smaller upfront commit ($120k) + guaranteed burst bucket (200 GPU-hrs/month) + higher overage unit price to protect capacity. Also proposed a trial 'burst-first' waiver for first 90 days.

Security/compliance: customer requires SOC2 + SSO/SAML, optional KMS integration. Residency clause: data-at-rest for embeddings must stay in US for 2 years retention. Legal wants tighter SLA language around fallback to hosted variants during Dedicated outages.

Customer quotes: "We need predictable monthly bills — spikes in Q4 killed last year's margins. If we can cap unit cost during ramp, we can commit to 12 months." — Head of Product
